title: 記憶：短期記憶與長期記憶

bullets.text: 作者認為，上下文中的 in-context learning 可以視為短期記憶。
bullets.quote: Short-term memory: I would consider all the in-context learning (See Prompt Engineering) as utilizing short-term memory of the model to learn.

bullets.text: 短期記憶受上下文視窗長度限制，因此很有限。
bullets.quote: It is short and finite, as it is restricted by the finite context window length of Transformer.

bullets.text: 長期記憶通常是外部向量資料庫，需要時用快速檢索取回。
bullets.quote: Long-term memory: This provides the agent with the capability to retain and recall (infinite) information over extended periods, often by leveraging an external vector store and fast retrieval.
